I genuinely don't know if this is satire or not but if it IS real then we need to be having a SERIOUS conversation about the legal framework governing outer-belt transit authorities. The OCTA charter hasn't been meaningfully updated since 2704 and the rebrand loophole in Section 12(c) allows a board to functionally dissolve and reconstitute an agency without triggering the public-review requirements that would normally apply to a service reduction of this magnitude. This is not a branding issue. This is a governance crisis. I will be writing about this at length.
